issues.title: Bengaluru: conversion down across the city
issues.cause: Market problem, not one store: city conversion 13.0% vs 14.5% in the same 13 weeks last year (-10%, rest of the network -2%); 4 of 4 stores are down.

action.what: At today's morning call, tell all 4 Bengaluru store managers the drop is city-wide, not their store; keep full Saturday and Sunday rosters and compare stores with each other, not with last year

issues.rupees_formula: (city conversion last year − now) × walk-ins (13 wks) × avg bill value, per 4 weeks, then × 30.4/28 to show per month
